g1.label: 1. A good paraphrase is roughly the ___
g1.why: The text says a good paraphrase is roughly the same length as the original.

g2.label: 2. Techniques include using ___
g2.why: The text says to use synonyms to replace key words.

g3.label: 3. Changing the ___ of the sentence
g3.why: The text says to change the grammatical structure of the sentence.

g4.label: 4. The ___ must remain exactly the same
g4.why: The text says the meaning must remain exactly the same as the original.

g5.label: 5. Summarizing condenses text into a much ___ version
g5.why: The text says summarizing condenses a text into a much shorter version.

g6.label: 6. A summary focuses only on the ___
g6.why: The text says a summary focuses only on the main ideas.

g7.label: 7. Both skills help you avoid ___
g7.why: The text says both paraphrasing and summarizing help you avoid plagiarism.

g8.label: 8. You must still include a proper ___
g8.why: The text says you must still include a proper in-text citation to credit the author.
